mapper.select: SELECT 'STO' AS TARGET_TYPE, R.STORE_NO AS TARGET_NO, MAX(R.REVIEW_NO) AS LAST_REVIEW_NO FROM review R LEFT JOIN review_summary RS ON RS.TARGET_TYPE = 'STO' AND RS.TARGET_NO = R.STORE_NO WHERE R.STORE_NO IS NOT NULL AND RS.SUMMARY_NO IS NULL GROUP BY R.STORE_NO HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minReviewCount}

SELECT 'PRD' AS TARGET_TYPE, R.PRODUCT_NO AS TARGET_NO, MAX(R.REVIEW_NO) AS LAST_REVIEW_NO FROM review R LEFT JOIN review_summary RS ON RS.TARGET_TYPE = 'PRD' AND RS.TARGET_NO = R.PRODUCT_NO WHERE R.PRODUCT_NO IS NOT NULL AND RS.SUMMARY_NO IS NULL GROUP BY R.PRODUCT_NO HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minReviewCount}
SELECT REVIEW_NO, STORE_NO, USER_ID, RATING, R_CONTENTS, CDATE FROM review WHERE STORE_NO = #{targetNo} ORDER BY REVIEW_NO DESC LIMIT #{reviewLimit}
SELECT REVIEW_NO, PRODUCT_NO, USER_ID, RATING, R_CONTENTS, CDATE FROM review WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{targetNo} ORDER BY REVIEW_NO DESC LIMIT #{reviewLimit}

SELECT R.RSV_NO, R.SLOT_NO, SL.SLOT_DATE, SL.SLOT_TIME, R.USER_ID, P.PET_NAME, P.SPECIES, P.BREED, M.MENU_NAME, M.MENU_PRICE, R.REQUEST, S.STORE_NO, S.STORE_NAME FROM RESERVATION R JOIN RSV_SLOT SL ON R.SLOT_NO = SL.SLOT_NO JOIN PET P ON R.PET_NO = P.PET_NO JOIN STORE_MENU M ON R.MENU_NO = M.MENU_NO JOIN STORE S ON R.STORE_NO = S.STORE_NO WHERE R.RSV_NO = #{rsvNo}
SELECT SUMMARY_NO, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_NO, SUMMARY_TEXT, LAST_REVIEW_NO, SUMMARY_STATUS, CDATE, UDATE FROM review_summary WHERE TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType} AND TARGET_NO = #{targetNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (USER_ID, STORE_NO, RSV_NO, RATING, R_CONTENTS, CDATE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{storeNo}, #{rsvNo}, #{rating}, #{rContents}, NOW())
INSERT INTO review (USER_ID, PRODUCT_NO, ORD_NO, RATING, R_CONTENTS, CDATE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productNo}, #{ordNo}, #{rating}, #{rContents}, NOW())
INSERT INTO review_file (REVIEW_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, FILE_SIZE, FILE_EXT) VALUES (#{reviewNo}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{originName}, #{fileSize}, #{fileExt})

INSERT INTO review_summary ( TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_NO, SUMMARY_TEXT, LAST_REVIEW_NO, SUMMARY_STATUS, CDATE, UDATE ) VALUES ( #{targetType}, #{targetNo}, #{summaryText}, #{lastReviewNo}, #{summaryStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE review_summary SET SUMMARY_TEXT = #{summaryText}, LAST_REVIEW_NO = #{lastReviewNo}, SUMMARY_STATUS = #{summaryStatus}, UDATE = NOW() WHERE TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType} AND TARGET_NO = #{targetNo}
